verify: for f in docs/references/US/mutcd-11th-edition-*.pdf docs/references/US/mutcd-final-rule-2023-27178.pdf docs/references/US/prowag-final-rule-2023-16149.pdf docs/references/US/shs-2004-2012-supplement.pdf docs/references/US/massdot-mutcd-11th-amendments-2026.pdf; do head -c 4 "$f" | grep -q '%PDF' || echo "BAD MAGIC: $f"; done
